# Learnings and mistakes

No structural facts are generated for this page; the store has no concept of a mistake, only of records, decisions and handovers. Everything here is written by hand.

## Notes (human, preserved verbatim on regeneration)

<!-- bm-human:begin -->
MISTAKES:
- Skipped the baton ceremony at the previous stop; founder scored 1/5. Root cause: I treated the ceremony as a session-end duty instead of a brothermode-close duty, and the session kept going. Fix recorded in 03.
- CI went red on first push of v1.5.0: a nested same-quote f-string valid on local 3.13, SyntaxError on CI 3.11. Caught because I checked the run instead of trusting the badge. Lesson: the CI floor version is the compatibility contract; local green is not.

LEARNINGS:
- A prevented or projected saving is a counterfactual: ESTIMATED, never VERIFIED. Only a real before and after over the same window earns VERIFIED. This single correction reshaped the roadmap (Fable's judging catch on the blueprint's own hero math).
- Rolling mtime windows can overlap cohorts and a resumed transcript pollutes them; message-timestamp cohorts are the correct experiment design (adopted into ADVISOR-PLAN.md).
- ChatGPT blueprints state facts with confidence that may be invented (hook names, settings keys, repo owners). Verification sweep before build, always.
- A plugin's commands live in its own namespace: /token-saver:stats was impossible; it landed as /token-shield:stats.

NEAR MISSES:
- .local-out/token-shield.html (a rendered dashboard of the founder's own numbers) was one git add -A from the public repo; caught in staged review, now gitignored.
- The optimizer's own guard regex tripped the repo attribution scan; reworded the pattern rather than weakening the scan.
<!-- bm-human:end -->
